Overview

There are currently 886 building developments in Jumeirah Village Circle. Of these, 456 are complete, 24 are at the planning stage, 186 are at various stages of construction, and eight are either on-hold or facing construction delays.

There were also 219 projects that have either been cancelled or never made it off the drawing board. For historical record, we list them all at the bottom of this page.

Each building has its own dedicated guide with project images, statistics, property listings and price history charts.

Please note that the buildings on this page are limited to residential and commercial buildings only. We do not include stations, bridges, communication towers, municipality buildings, or government buildings such as palaces or embassies.

Livel Residenza, Oakyard Residences, Parkwood Residences, Azizi Ruby, Sapphire 32, Azurline Residences, The Fifth, Violet Tower, Rose Gardens 2, Havelock Heights, Xenia Residences, Samana Manhattan 2, 77 Boulevard by Bam, Gharbi 2 Residences, Hillmont Residences, Samha Residence 2 JVC, Avant Garde Residences, The Orchard Place Tower C, Eco Harmony Tower, Vue by Crystal Bay, Golden Wood Views 5, Sereno Residences, Exotica by Al Marina, Belle Reve, Luxor Residences, Ozone1 Residence, Oasis by Lucky Aeon, Skyhills Residences 2, Blossom 76 by Tranquil, Helvetia Residences, Casa Vista Residence, Aveline Residences, Palatium Residences, Waref Residences by Sido, Almaan 101, Binghatti Apex, The Veranda Collection 2, Riviera Lodge, Samana Waves 2, Binghatti Grove, Vitality Residence, Binghatti Amberhall, Pearl House 3, Roma Residences by JRP, and Aria Heights are due for completion this year. The Autograph I Series, Sky Harmony, Nexara Tower, One Sky Park, Pearl House 4, Binghatti Ruby, Maison Elysee 3, Avana Residences, The Autograph S Series, Floarea Skies, Lume Residence, Veda by Aum One, Binghatti Etherea, Legado By Prescott, Provenza Residences, Orchid Residence by Fortune 5, 311 Boulevard, Q Gardens Aliya, Iridian Park, Tetris Tower, Iridian Park 2, Norah Residence, One Park Central, Allura Residences, J Haus Residences, Skyhills Residences 3, Acube Electra, Maison Elysee, Alfal Residence, MAK I'Sola Bella, and 105 Residences by Kamdar are due for completion in 2027. SquareX One, SVN Residences, Alta View Skyhomes, Stax Towers, Capital One JVC, One Park Square, Celestara Residences, Avant Garde 2 Residences, Solena at The Orchard Place, 368 Park Lane, Greygate Residences, The Weave, Noble Crest, The Borough, Berkeley Square, Tresora by Wadan, Rose Gold Residences, and Vivanti Residences are due for completion in 2028. Serenz by Danube is due for completion in 2029

Centre Court, GGICO JVC Tower, Parkwood Villas 1, Jehaan Residence 1, Jehaan Residence 7, Untitled Plot JVC16BMRM004, Untitled Plot JVC17TCP003D, and Untitled Plot JVC10AAMRH006 are all either on hold or facing delays in construction.
